source.title: A Difficult Path
source.description:
There is a fount of great power residing at the base of the World Tree, high atop Mount Hyjal. This is a place of ancient and storied history; it was recently the focus of the final clash between the defenders of Azeroth and the Burning Legion. It is now a haunted place, steeped in the power of light and shadow... life and death.

This power mirrors the duality of the blade and we will see the weapon tempered there. Reaching the summit of the mountain will be no small feat, however.
source.progress: The original blade was tempered in the the blood of a nation falling to flame, war, and darkness. There's ancient, and eldritch magic in such things.
source.completion:
The druids have jealously guarded the secrets of Hyjal since the end of the Third War. They are not your only obstacle, however. Scourge remnants, wilds gods, demons... even dragons stalk the mountainside. With luck, an  opportunity will present itself that will allow you to bypass those dangers.

We can but hope that fortune will smile upon you.
